description: This file implements a system notification handler for an Android application, including classes and functions to create, manage, and post system notifications, handle permissions, and parse JSON request parameters.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking authorization and posting notifications.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for Android, handling notification permission checks and notifications creation.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class handling system notifications, parsing requests, and orchestrating notification posting.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the app has notification permissions and notifications are enabled.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates and posts a notification based on a SystemNotifyRequest.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures notification channel exists for specified priority.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts priority string to NotificationCompat priority constant.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines whether the sound parameter indicates a silent notification.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Main method for handling notification requests, parsing JSON parameters, authorization, and posting notifications.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject.
